Type-safe window expressions have been implemented in `drizzle-orm` on the branch `feat/window-functions` and committed.

### Summary of Implementation

1. **Window Function Helpers & Frame Utilities (`drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts`)**:
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts).
   - **Offset / Value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts).
   - **Aggregates**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts).
   - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts).
   - **Top-level package exports**: Re-exported through [drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts) to the root index.

2. **Builder & Constraint Enforcement**:
   - `WindowBuilder.over(spec)` supports empty specification (`over ()`), inline specs (`partitionBy`, `orderBy`, `frame`), and named window references (`over "name"` without parentheses).
   - Numeric positional arguments (e.g. in `ntile`, `nthValue`, `lag`, `lead`, `preceding`, `following`) are formatted with `sql.raw` so they are never parameterized.
   - Non-positive integer checks on `ntile` and `nthValue` throw with the JS function name and received value.
   - Negative and non-integer checks on `preceding()` and `following()` throw with the helper name.
   - Frame boundary ordering checks in `rows()` and `range()` validate that `from` is not after `to` and mention `"from"`.
   - `windowCount()` with no arguments emits `count(*)`.
   - Value-access functions type column values as nullable (`T | null`), and `lag`/`lead` strip nullability when a non-nullable default value is supplied.

3. **Query Builder Support Across Dialects**:
   - Added `.window(name, spec)` to select query builders for `pg-core`, `mysql-core`, `sqlite-core`, `singlestore-core`, and `gel-core`.
   - Enforced empty-name (`"non-empty"`) and whitespace-only name (`"whitespace"`) validations.
   - Dialect query builders compile `WINDOW <name> AS (<spec>)` directly before `ORDER BY`.

4. **Testing & Verification**:
   - Comprehensive unit and type tests in [drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fsmr0s7m/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts).
   - Code formatting verified via `dprint` (`pnpm lint`).
   - Monorepo type check (`pnpm test:types`) and unit tests (`pnpm vitest run`) pass cleanly.
